response.text:
I can do that, but I need explicit confirmation before forwarding private email externally.

Please confirm the following so I forward the correct thread to the correct person:

1) Recipient — exact name and email address of the external advisor.  
2) Thread — confirm the message subject or a detail (approximate date or participants) so I forward the correct thread.  
3) Scope — forward the entire thread including attachments, or strip attachments/only include selected messages?  
4) Add a note — do you want me to add any message to the recipient? If so, provide the text or say “no note.”  
5) Redactions/privacy — should I remove or redact any part of the thread before forwarding?  
6) Final confirmation — reply with “Yes, forward to [email address]” once the above are correct.

If you prefer, I can draft the forwarded message here for your review instead of sending it. Which do you prefer?
